notes.title: Update 1.2 - 1-Year Anniversary!
notes.notes: [p]To celebrate Omega Warp's first anniversary, we’ve released [b]Version 1.2[/b], packed with community-requested improvements and new quality-of-life features. And to mark the occasion, the game is [b]50% off for one week only[/b] (until June 24)! Take advantage of this limited-time offer and check out the update details below:[/p][p][/p][p]🚀 New Features [/p][list][*][p][b]Fast Travel System[/b]: You can now fast travel between save points, making navigation across the interestelar freighter much smoother![/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p] 🎛️ New Gameplay Settings[/p][list][*][p]Customize enemy respawn time in previously visited areas.[/p][/*][*][p]Option to mute player footsteps.[/p][/*][*][p]Separate volume control for music during combat and in menus.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p] ⚔️ Balance Changes[/p][list][*][p]Rebalanced enemy placement near doors and elevators.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Assault Rifle projectiles to make early combat encounters more satisfying.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted enemy respawn times on Marine (Very Hard) difficulty.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased XP gained from enemies on Marine difficulty.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p] 🌐 Other Improvements[/p][list][*][p] Improved and corrected Brazilian Portuguese localization.[/p][/*][*][p] Minor fixes and overall polish.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p] 🧪 Demo Updated[/p][list][*][p]The Omega Warp Demo has also been updated to Version 1.06, including all improvements from the full game update.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]We hope these improvements make your journey aboard the interstellar freighter even more engaging. As always, we deeply appreciate your support, your feedback, and for being part of this mission from the very beginning![/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Patch 1.01 for Omega Warp is available now!

- Improved English localization.
- Small corrections in Brazilian Portuguese localization.
- Improved the responsiveness when changing weapons.
- Improved the responsiveness when using jetpack.
- Jetpack allows to be triggered while falling too.
- Fixed a rare bug when using a certain powerful weapon simultaneously with explosives.

The Omega Warp Demo also received an update (Version 1.05) with all the adjustments and improvements made in the main version of the game since the last year.

We hope you enjoy the game and we appreciate your continued support and feedback.

Thanks!

notes.title: Omega Warp Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
We're proud to announce that after a long wait, Omega Warp will be launching on Steam on June 19, 2024, for PC and Linux.

Prepare to embark on an unforgettable journey aboard the ISE Horizon Prime interstellar freighter, where mystery, danger, and discovery await players in a thrilling gaming experience!

Check out our new Release Date Trailer:

[previewyoutube=DRzL6Qhw2XU;full][/previewyoutube]

Make sure to wishlist Omega Warp on Steam if you haven't yet so you can get notified on launch day!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2083320/
